name: motif_edit_adhoc_prohibition
description:
Edit an ad hoc prohibition. Research first: motif_guide topic ask-the-linguist or suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Use only if an existing prohibition should be switched off or on; otherwise remove the need with a slot, template, feature or environment (guides suffix-prefix-slots, feature-conditioned-slots). Stages one explicit Disabled value for a flat allomorph or morpheme prohibition in a Draft. The expected value guards against stale evidence; Motif never Applies this change automatically. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-adhoc-prohibition. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of one flat allomorph or morpheme prohibition.

expected_disabled.description: The value the target must currently have.

disabled.description: The explicit Disabled value to write.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
